brief:
The family of Yamen Alloush, an 18-year-old detainee from Nablus, warned of his deteriorating health in Negev prison after he contracted scabies and lost 10 kilograms, Shehab Wire reported. The family appealed to the International Committee of the Red Cross to intervene.

Alloush is among Palestinian detainees held in the facility. His family said his condition has worsened since his imprisonment.
